newsitem.title: USA: Atlantis Plastics sells Tulsa film facility.
newsitem.headline: Atlantis Plastics sells Tulsa film facility.

text.p: Atlantis Plastics Inc said on Monday it sold its Tulsa, Okla., custom film facility to a group of private investors for $1.5 million in cash.
The company said that the net cash proceeds after taxes and expenses would be used for general corporate purposes.
Atlantis said the sale was part of its strategy to dispose of non-strategic assets, improve production efficiency, and lower production and overhead costs.
Compared to 1995 levels, the company reduced its overall cost structure in about $7 million, and net debt to less than $95 million versus $115 million at December 31.
